entities.summary: Charles John Brown is an American prelate of the Catholic Church who has been serving as an apostolic nuncio since 2012. He is currently the apostolic nuncio to the Philippines, and previously served the same role in Albania and Ireland. He was consecrated as an archbishop in 2012.
